translation.name: Urim-Kalpm
translation.englishName: Urim: Wurkapm a Maur Wailen Portions

content: Tu wi Jisas ye kai ntekg yangkipm atn kai ikg a Pailat
Tu hong tukgunakgen wrongwailet ntekg yangkipm namponen Jisas plaln pa, wa tu nel wiyel ha pa ye kai ekg Pailat,

yatom la kiti nasi Pailat pa la tolpa, “Men ari melnum ti pa kil wa lok tu wrong kinkpman alpmenen ti kai hor ya paitn, wa kil wa loko ekg ake al men piln takis marpm kai ekg Sisar, melnum tukgunakgen a kipm Rom pa, wa kil kat nang a kil alkil ti la tolpa kil ti Krais, melnum tukgunakgen a Maur Wailen kwa nar akal akwi tu wrong kinkpman.”
Yatom Pailat pa ropontel la tolpa, “Ti kitn pa melnum tukgunakgen a tu Juta pake?” Ari wa Jisas akalmpe la tolpa, “Apm kitn alkitn pa la pa apm tolpake.”
Yatom wa Pailat pa la nasi tu melnum a tu ipma krakgen a Maur Wailen a atn hep pa, wa tu wrongwailet a atn pa la tolpa, “Melnum ti ake kupm ari tolpa kil ntekg paitn ur.”

Ari wa tu wa la titnongket paitn la tolpa, “Kil pike akwap ro tukgunakg lngkep a tu wrong kinkpman atn hor ha knokg Jutia ti. Pike kil katen atn kai ha knokg Kalili ai yatom wa ye hor ti kul tike. Tolpa yatom kil ak ntekg nikgwalpm a tu wrong kinkpman pa ark hor pa hor pa.”
Tu wi Jisas ye kai ntekg yangkipm atn kai ikg a Herot
Pailat kil atning a tu melnum wail wail la tolpa yatom kil roponten la tolpa, “Kil ti melnum a Kalili?”

Tu akalmpe la tolpa, “Ei, kil melnum a Kalili pake.” Yatom Pailat la nasi tu ekg tu wiyel ye kai ekg Herot ekg nte, Herot pa kil atn melnum tukgunakgen ikghlen ha knokg Kalili pake. Ak wang pa, Herot apm arpm Jerusalem pa yat pake.

Tu wiyel ye kai paln, om Herot ari Jisas tolpa kil utopen paitn, ekg nte, kil pike atning a tu la Jisas pa, yatom kil pike lantwang atn wang watin ekg kil akal ariel. Wa kil akwonalmpen akal ari Jisas ntekg kwei ur weten ak titnongket alkilen ekg al kil ari.
Yatom Herot kil ropon Jisas ekla wailet, ari ake kil akalmpe ekla ur.
Ari tu melnum ipma krakgen a Maur Wailen a atn hep pa namponen tu melnum a arpmen yangkipm yiprokgen a Maur Wailen pa a ntiel atn pa nel lawel titnongket la tolpa, kil melnum a ntekg paitn paitn.
Yatom Herot namponen tu melnum alkilen a almpwrong pa, nel ari la paitnel, wa ak hinowel. Yatom tu wi hapm ariwor ur pa nowel plaln pa, nel kwawel wa kai ekg Pailat.
Ak wang ripa, Herot ekg Pailat a pike wrongmnto ekg tita pa, wa ekg kai hor wrij.
Pailat wi wor ekg tu al karkurn Jisas kai yo kwatingki
Yatom Pailat kil kwe tu melnum ipma krakgen a Maur Wailen a atn hep, wa tu melnum wail wail pa namponen tu wrong kinkpman pa nel kul.

Yatom kil la nasen la tolpa, “Wet kipm wiyel ye kul hep pa, kipm la tolpa kil ak ntekg nikgwalpm a tu wrong kinkpman pa kai hor pa hor pa, pake kupm wet ariel a atning yangkipm akil pa kai ikg a kipm pa, ari ake kupm ari kil ntekg paitn ur, tol a kipm lawel pa.
Wa Herot pa yat ake wa kil ari a kil ntekg paitn ur, tolpa yatom wa kil kwawel wa kul ekg mento ti. Ti melnum ti ake ntekg paitn ur, ekg al mento almpel mo pa.
Ti al kupm la tolpa tu erel, plaln pa, kupm kwawel ekg kil kai.”
Ari tu kinkpman wrongwailet a atn pa nel la yikaktnen la tolpa, “Er kil pa mo om! Wa, kwa Parapas pa kulhor hen!”
Tol Parapas pa pike wreitn nti tu akal talpuln kwan tu melnum wail wail a ikghlen ha wail ti kai tukulein, om alm melnum ur mo, yatom tu wiyel ye kai arpm wan tipmning.
Pake Pailat pa wakrongen tolpa al kwa Jisas pa kahor hen, yatom wa kil la nasi tu wrong kinkpman pa nti ur.
Ari wa tu la yikaktnen la tolpa, “Erel om! Erel om! Er mo om! Kurkurntel kai yo kwatingki pa om!”

Wet Pailat roponten nti wekg ase, ari wa kil wa roponten nti ur la tolpa, “Pike kil ntekg kuina paitn? Ake kupm ari kil pa ntekg paitn ur ekg al kipm erel mo pa! Ti al kupm la tolpa tu erel plaln pa, kupm kwawel ekg kil kai.”
Ari tu atn pa atn pa la plulnplaln mainmain la tolpa, kurkurn Jisas pa om. Yatom ekla a tu pa ak hangken ekla a Pailat pa.
Kil atning a tu wrongwailet tu la titnongket tolpa yatom, kil wi wor ekg al tu karkurn Jisas kai yo kwatingki.

Yatom kil kwa melnum a tu wakrongen a pike talpuln kwan tu melnum wail wail a ikghlen ha wail ti kai tukulein, om alm melnum ur mo. Yatom tu wiyel arpm wan tipmning pa kulhor hen, om kil eln Jisas pa kai wam a tu alntu pa al tu ntekg ak wakrong alntuen.
Tu wi Jisas ye kai akal karkurntel kai yo kwatingki

Yatom tu melnum almpwrong tu wi Jisas pa tolti, tu ye kai. Tu ngkom kai pa, tu hantil melnum ur pa, nang akil pa Saimon, kil melnum kai ha wail Sairini. Kil kul akal kai kahor Jerusalem pa, ari tu lokel tolti tu ukwel yo kwatingki a Jisas pa ekg kil kat ye katnun Jisas pa ntien ye kai.
Tu wrong wailet paitn tu katnun Jisas, namponen tu kin tiur pa, hakg la ak ek namputen reinjel.
Ari Jisas pleln la nasen la tolpa, “Kipm kin a Jerusalem pa! Ampur kipm hakg rein ekg kupm ti pa, kipm hakg rein ekg kipm alkipm ti a ekg tu warim alkipmen pa yat!
Wang ur hi wa paln, yatom tu hi la tolpa, ‘Tu kin a kmpongmamukij, wa tu kin wnakul, wa tu kin a pike ake uk ma warim pa, ak wang pa tu pa hi utopen pake.’
Ak wang pa, tu wrongwailet hi wa la nasi tipmning ti la tolpa, ‘Tpor nar ak hauro!’ Om wa la wrik nang ti la tolpa, ‘Ik lampo!’
Yo mahin kil pa tu ntekg tolpake, wa yo nungkwor pa hi wa tu ntekg paitn wrijen ai.”
Tu karkurn Jisas ark yo kwatingki
Tu melnum almpwrong pa wi melnum wekg ur ye kul, melnum wekg a pike ntekg paitnpaitn, ekg akal karkurnten mo namponen Jisas pa.
Yatom tu kul paln kul wrik a tu namput tolpa Melnum Tukgunakg Tmpal pa, tu karkurn Jisas kai yo kwatingki namponen melnum ikgwampet wekg pa, ur ark wam wien pa, wa ur ark wam wangkekg.

Yatom Jisas kil la tolpa, “Yan! Kitn kwan paitnpaitn a tu ti, ekg nte, tu ake ari kuina ur a tu ntekg ti.” Yatom tu utop ekg nalu yo hpin, ekg akal ari tolpa mla ur nalu watin pa, al tu pa nampreng hapm alkilen pake.

Yatom tu wrong kinkpman pa nel atn ikghnen tolpa atn, tu melnum wail wail pa yat nel akhinowel Jisas pa la tolpa, “Kil pike aklin tu tiur ai. Ti tol kil melnum a pike Maur Wailen akrkahan aklahle akal kil akwi tu wrong kinkpman pa, ti kil iklin kil alkil ti yat om!”
Wa tu melnum a almpwrong pa yat nel wa akhinowel, nel kulno tolti ukwel hu wain a armpen ak marpm wasok pa ekg kil akal al,
yatom tu nel la tolpa, “Tol kitn melnum tukgunakgen a tu wrong kinkpman a Juta ti pa, kitn iklin kitn alkitn ti om!”
Hel kaino yo tukgunakg pa tu ro la tolpa, “Melnum rikil pa kil tukgunakgen a tu Juta.”

Wa melnum ikgwampet ur a ark kai yamping wompel a Jisas pa kil wa la akhinowel la tolpa, “Ti kitn ti, kitn melnum a pike Maur Wailen kil akrkahanteitn aki? Pati, wa kitn iklin kitn alkitn ti ri, om wa kitn iklin mentekg ti yat!”
Ari wa ur a ark yamping wompel pa kle ur a la ark kai yamping wompel pa la tolpa, “Ti kitn ake kark ekg Maur Wailen ti? Ti kitn apm ye kalkut wrij tol a kil ye pake.
Tol mentekg ti tu karkurnto komkiti paitn a pike mentekg ntekg pa, pake kil pa ake pike ntekg paitn ur, kalpm.”
Yatom kil la nasi Jisas pa la tolpa, “Jisas, ak wang a hi kitn paln wailen atn kahor kingdom a kitn pa, hi kitn ikwonilmpentopm!”
Ari wa Jisas la nasel la tolpa, “Kupm la naseitn aklahle wrijen la tolpa, am ti kitn pal nti kupm arpm kaino ha Paradais tike.”
Jisas kil mo

Yatom ak takgni no arpm kuin pa, eln kul kai mning karn tolti ak hmpri takgni ti, ak haur ha knokg wrongwailet pa, atn kaingkai, om wang kai wi wraur pa, mning pa apm kai plaln ase, wa hapm wail a lekg ark kai wan yalming a Maur Wailen pa rekel wom wekg.
Yatom Jisas kil wlakil hakg yikaktnen ak ek namputen yan alkilen pa la tolpa, “Yan, wi maur wor akupm pa om!” Kil la tolpa, om kil apm mo ase.
Melnum a atn hep ekg tu melnum a almpwrong pa kil ari kweiur kweiur a paln, tolpa yatom kil kat nang a Maur Wailen pa la tolpa, “Aklahle wrijen, kil pa melnum nipet wor.”
Wang a tu wrongwailet a kul ark pa tu ari kweiur kweiur a paln tolpa pa, tu rein paitn tolti, om homtmpok wam kli won tolti om tu pleln wa kaingkai wan ha alntuen ai.
Tu yiprokgen, wa tu melnum wor a Jisas pa, wa tu kin a katnuntel hakaino Kalili ai nar pa, nel atn watin ketn ketn yatom ari kweiur kweiur a paln ripa.
Tu uwen yipmri a Jisas

Melnum ur pa, tu kwe tolpa Josep, melnum ur kai ha wail Arimatea. Ti pa ha ur a ark ha knokg a Jutia, pa kil melnum nipet wor a arpm nungkwangen akal ari Kingdom a Maur Wailen. Kil pa apm wa hong tukgunakgen a arpm atning yangkipm pa yat pake, pake kil ake pike ipma wrij namponen tu kwapwrij alkilen a tu arpm yipon yangkipm ekg ak nikgwalpm tolpa ekg Jisas pa.
Yatom kil kai kahor ari Pailat pa, ekg akal wi yipmri a Jisas pa ye kai uwen.

Om Pailat wi wor, om kil kulhor kai nalu yipmri a Jisas pa tolti, ye nar ak hapm tungkoren pa yipo plaln om, kil kat ye kai elnthel kahor tipmning teng wonen ur a pike tu uwe weten pa, a ake pike tu eln kmel ur hele pen, kalpm.

Yatom wang pa, wang a tu numprampen kweiur kweiur ekg arpm ekg wi yapm, pa tol wet ti kai eln ak nungkutikg ari kmel ikgukg wekg pa, wa katen ha pa kai hikgkil pa wang miten pa, pa wang wail a tu arpm ekg yapm pake.
Tu kin tiur a pike nti Jisas hakaino Kalili ai nar pa nel katnun Josep pa, yatom tu ari tipmning teng pa, wa ari a kil eln yipmri a Jisas pa elnthel tolhai.
Tolti, tu wa kai numprampen hu yuwa a wa kweiur kweiur wepmij ekg akal ak nel yipmri akil pa. Yatom ak wang wail pa, tu arpm ekg yapm tol a yangkipm titnongket la pa.

footnotes.text: 23.16-17 Tu melnum arie tiur akwonalmpen tolpa, yangkipm wompel ur ha kirng ripa yat. Yangkipm wompel pa la tolpa: “Aklei wring wrij wrij a tu ntekg ekpma wail al al tolti pa, Pailat kil al kwa melnum wrij ur a arpm wan tipmning pa kulhor hen.”
23.38 Ari kil yangkipm yiprokgen a tu karkurn Jisas mo kai yo kwatingki, pa tu ro ak ek hawen wraur: Krik, Latin, Hipru.
